question: One day, Rekha was standing facing the east. She then turned 90 degrees right and then turned 45 degrees in the anti-clockwise direction. She then turned 90 degrees clockwise. Which direction is she facing now?
solution:
Given:

 
• Rekha was standing facing the east.
 
• Then turned 90 degrees right.
 
• Then turned 45 degrees in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Then turned 90 degrees clockwise.

According to the given information, we get the following figure

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a43951971ebe23aa87e460b0f10449cce66da18888035779ee9b51328411beab.png] 

Therefore, the direction Rekha is facing right now is South - West.

Hence, the correct answer is **"South - West".**
